title_en: Why Most Profitable Businesses Stay Invisible: Business vs. VC Startup in the AI Era
dek_en: In a recent video, the host of the channel 课代表立正 argues that AI has changed the economics of starting a company without changing the test every company still has to pass. Business and VC startup differ in their growth requirements, but both rest on product-market fit.
title_zh: AI 时代的生意与 VC Startup：为什么赚钱的好生意大多看不见
dek_zh: 「课代表立正」在一期视频中提出：AI 改变了创业的成本结构，却没有改变创业需要通过的那道考题。讲者区分了「生意」与「VC Startup」两种不同的游戏——差别在于增长要求，而共同的底层是 PMF；并指出技术难度不等于市场价值，留存与信任才决定增长上限。
